summary: Stewards, Inc. filed an 8-K/A amending its September 29, 2026 report on the completed acquisition of Envy Pompano Beach, closed September 23, 2026. The amendment restates escrow accounting: 7,000,000 escrowed shares are treated as mandatorily redeemable financial instruments under ASC 480, carried as a current liability at a preliminary $20.043 million fair value, representing seven $3.0 million payments ($21.0 million total) discounted at an 18.0% effective rate. The 7,263,025 rollover shares are recorded in equity at the $2.42 closing price, about $17.577 million, yielding preliminary consideration of roughly $84.830 million. Watch valuation finalization, auditor review, and redemption timing October 2026 through April 2027.
